statement.p: Out of the last 40 days, it rained 11 days. What percent of these days did it rain?

solution.p: We recall that a percent is part/whole scaled by 100. Here we have \displaystyle\frac{{11}}{{40}}={0.275}. We convert this to a percent by \displaystyle{100}\cdot{0.275}={27.5} . Lastly we round to two decimal places. The rounded percent is 27.5 .
